bB5t3cET4aMGm0","type":"text","text":"I've completed the implementation of the low-stock products feature. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Changes

**`ProductController.java`**
- Added an optional `maxStock` parameter to `GET /api/products`, read as a raw `String` so "present but empty" (`maxStock=`) is distinguishable from "not given".
- Added `parseMaxStock()` which returns `null` when absent, but throws a `ConstraintViolationException` (yielding the existing `400` Problem Detail via `ApiExceptionHandler`) for empty, negative, or non-integer values.
- `maxStock` alone now selects the page form (FR-004).

**`ProductStore.java`**
- Extended `findPage(..., Integer maxStock)` to route among the four combinations (name × stock) while keeping filtering/counting in the database.

**`ProductRepository.java`**
- Added four queries: `findByStockAtMostPaged`, `countByStockAtMost`, `findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseAndStockAtMostPaged`, and `countByNameContainingIgnoreCaseAndStockAtMost` — each applying `stock <= :maxStock` next to the escaped `name` condition (FR-005).

**`ProductLowStockTests.java`** (new)
- 16 tests covering every acceptance scenario and edge case (stock filtering, exact-limit inclusion, combining with name/paging, wildcard literal matching, PATCH/reservation/deletion behavior, plain-array fallback, very large limits, and all four invalid values).

## Verification
- `mvn -B test`: **118 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors** — all pre-existing 001–010 tests pass unedited, and the new low-stock tests pass.
